adapters.label: Cursor
adapters.context_loading: Cursor auto-attaches matching .cursor/context/*.mdc files by frontmatter globs.
adapters.rules_loading: Cursor auto-attaches .cursor/rules/*.mdc files by alwaysApply or globs.
adapters.note: Cursor entry files are committed, but rules/context/skills are generated from plugins/.

adapters.label: Codex CLI
adapters.context_loading: Read AGENT.md as the canonical router. Project facts stay in docs/; Cursor .mdc context is not auto-loaded by Codex.
adapters.rules_loading: Hard stops and code discipline come from AGENT.md. Cursor-only .mdc rules are optional manual context outside Cursor.
adapters.skills_loading: Use generated .codex/skills/<plugin>__<skill>/SKILL.md when available; manual skill loading is fallback only.
adapters.note: Codex reads AGENTS.md at repo root; skills are generated from plugins/.
